name: Occult Hand of the Blood Lily
source:
1877. The Dominion has fallen, and Europe has descended into fetid squalor. The Sky Wars rage on as raiders and crusaders duel in the air and pillage the ruined cities below. Vampiric lords carve up the continent and leave the scraps for distant empires to colonize and exploit.

And in all of that, some still manage to eke out a peaceful life. Milli, daughter of a former lord in a secluded mountain village, lives as a hobbyist scholar, researching magic, science, and literature at her own pleasure. It’s a lonely life, but she has every intention of living out her days in safety. That is, until the Occult Hand attacks her home, kills her family, and pursues her across the continent.

She’s only alive because of her willpower, her cunning, and her mysterious guardian, a vampire named Ellison. Both of them want the same thing--the destruction of the Occult Hand. And the only way to achieve their goal is to find the legendary Blood Lily before they do.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4254290/Occult_Hand_of_the_Blood_Lily/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
1877年，自治领陷落，欧洲陷入恶臭肮脏之中。掠夺者和十字军在空中决斗，掠夺下方的废墟城市，天空之战愈演愈烈。吸血鬼领主瓜分了这片大陆，并将残骸留给遥远的帝国殖民和剥削。

尽管如此，一些人仍然设法维持平静的生活。米莉是一个僻静山村前领主的女儿，她是一名业余学者，随心所欲地研究魔法、科学和文学。这是一个孤独的生活，但她一心想安全地度过自己的日子。也就是说，直到神秘之手袭击了她的家，杀死了她的家人，并在整个大陆上追捕她。

她之所以能活着，全靠她的意志力、她的狡猾，还有她神秘的守护者——一个名叫埃里森的吸血鬼。他们俩都想要同一件事——毁灭神秘之手。而实现他们目标的唯一方法就是抢在他们之前找到传说中的血百合。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4254290/Occult_Hand_of_the_Blood_Lily/]Steam[/url]]
